We have a 2 Very hot position with our direct client Requirement Front End Developer &  Backend Developer position in Philadelphia, PA, If you have any matching resumes for the below mentioned position.

 

VERY URGENT AND IMMEDIATE NEED

 

Job Title: Front End Developer

Location: Philadelphia, PA

Duration: 06+ Months Contract

 

Need Front End Developer with Linux and Python

 

Job Description: 

This project will include update of an existing web portal offering the customer the ability to review and purchase devices based upon a variety of criteria. The frontend developer will be involved in the integration with new services offered to the customer, and improving the reliability of data provided by accessing it directly from the source. The frontend developer will have extensive experience writing web clients utilizing javascript.

 

Required skills include: Javascript, HTML, CSS, Angular.js.

Good to have: Linux, Ansible, Node.js.

 

 

We have a Requirement Backend Developer position in William Philadelphia, PA,

 

VERY URGENT AND IMMEDIATE NEED

 

1)    Job Title: Backend Developer

Location: Philadelphia, PA

Duration: 06+ Months Contract

 

Need Back End Developer with Linux and Python

 

Job Description:

This project will serve to improve the reliability of data presented to operational and end users alike. This will occur as the result of integrating and mapping as necessary data from multiple different systems.  Backend developer will be involved with backend integration of data sources, and may provide an integration layer for webapp access to key data, as well as requisite data migration.

 

Skills should include:

Database, Java, Javascript, Python.

Good to have: Linux, Ansible, Node.js, Angular.js.
